title: Choose the new look
question: The roll assigned Licence Paper. Keep it, take another one, or re-roll.

options.label: Licence Paper
options.lineage: UAE trade licences and government certificates
options.thesis: Your plan reads like a well-made official document, with a stamp on every official fee.
options.viewport: A document header with the plan's file number and fields, then 'Next step' as section 1, then the steps as a ruled table.
options.risk: Can feel like a bureaucratic form if the spacing gets cramped.

raised.raise: No shadows, gradients or icon tiles: lines and type size carry the order.
Details fold away: a step shows title, fee and status; the rest opens on tap.
One legend: Official, Estimate and Done mean one thing everywhere, explained once.
Strict numbering: the plan has a file number and every step a section number.
Money in aligned figures, on one grey scale.

options.label: Metro Line
options.thesis: The roadmap as a metro line: phases are stations, and you always see where you are.
options.viewport: A line of five stations from Prepare to Launch, a 'You are here' marker, and the next stop's steps below.
options.risk: The obvious reading of 'roadmap', so familiar; the line must not crowd small phones.

options.label: Boarding Pass
options.lineage: airline boarding passes and airport gate boards
options.thesis: The plan is your boarding pass; the steps sit on a departure board with live status.
options.viewport: A boarding-pass header (emirate, sector, budget) above a board of steps with their status.
options.case: Students raised around DXB know it well, but a business plan is not a flight, so it is less clear.
options.risk: Capital-letter labels everywhere slow down reading longer text.

options.label: Metro Tiles
options.thesis: Flat colour tiles and giant type, with no buttons or borders.
options.viewport: A sliding panorama of tiles, one per plan section.
options.case: Giant cropped type and sliding panoramas fight a simple task app.
options.risk: Hard to scan; black screens tire the eyes.
options.kept: No decoration: type and lines carry the order.

options.label: Streaming Wall
options.thesis: Rows of tiles where the focused one grows and shows its details.
options.viewport: Rows of plan cards scrolling sideways.
options.case: Plans are not posters to browse; sideways rows hide steps.
options.risk: Sideways scrolling is easy to miss on a laptop.
options.kept: Details stay folded until you open them.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: A course of numbered controls over a coloured terrain map.
options.viewport: A map with the steps as numbered circles on a course.
options.case: Few UAE students know orienteering, and its course colour is purple.
options.risk: Needs a map key before it makes sense.
options.kept: One fixed legend for every mark.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Black sleeves where colour codes replace words.
options.viewport: A numbered index of plans on black.
options.case: Coded labels are the opposite of plain words.
options.risk: Nobody can read a colour code without a key.
options.kept: Strict numbering for plans and steps.

options.label: Darkroom Record
options.thesis: Translucent sheets with hatching that shows how heavy each part is.
options.viewport: Overlapping sheets for each phase, hatched by cost.
options.case: Hatching and zone scales are too technical for first-time founders.
options.kept: Money in aligned figures on one grey scale.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean modern web app: white, one blue accent, cards and a top menu.
canonCard.viewport: Top menu, page title, then cards and tables the way most apps look.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other app; close to today's design without the purple.
